scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.check: node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/adaptiveQuizService.js && npm run build --prefix frontend
